title: An area of the Pokédex's habitat list: res/pokedex/habitats/<area>.json
description: The species of one area of the Pokédex's habitat screen (archive a/2/9/6, ARCID_POKEDEX_HABITAT; PokedexHabitatFile in include/app/pokedex_common.h), which src/ov302/pokedex_common.c reads. sPokedexHabitats there gives each area's zone and file, and tools/data/habitat_data.py packs the files in that order (its AREAS). It is not read by the encounters: an area's list should match the encounter tables of its zones. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

land_text.description: The habitat screen's message for the area's land habitat (unk6, PokedexHabitat_GetHabitatMessage): Pokémon living in the tall grass, in the sand, in the swamp, in this place, at this place, on the land, or no Pokémon lives here

habitats.description: The kinds of habitat the area has (conditions): the area is listed once the player has reached one of them, land always and water and fishing after the flags of PokedexCommon_GetConditions, and its award counts the species of each

by_season.description: For each kind of habitat, whether the screen shows its species by season (values); when not, it shows the spring ones

seasons.description: The seasons in which it lives there, none for never

forms.description: The form whose icon the screen shows, by kind of habitat and season, if the player has seen that form (other); all 0 when left out

unk1a.description: Two bytes that no code reads, 0 in every area; 0 when left out
